title: ProjectWorld Verify Baseline
description: Recorded output projection of one World producer verify and the verification identity it was recorded against, at Plugins/<Category>/<Plugin>/Data/TestFixtures/Verify/<generator_id>.verify.json in the producer's owning plugin. Only scripts/ue/world/record_verify_baseline.ps1 writes it; ordinary runs and the common checks only read it; production identity never reads it. projection_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the compact canonical serialization of records. Excluded from every projection on purpose: package bytes and package paths derived from random GUIDs, terrain reuse-identity tags, layout receipt provenance (schema_version, adapter_compiler_sha256, engine_identity, receipt_payload, receipt_sha256), manifest generation, operation, time, and fingerprint fields, artifact digest and semantic_sha256, compiled-section BuildInfo hashes, checksums, BuildKey, MegaMeshGUID, MegaMeshPath, and PackageDependencies.

identity.description: A change of any member permits a re-record; the same identity with different output fails and record mode refuses it.

engine_identity.description: SHA-256 of the running engine's Build/Build.version bytes.

embedded.description: Pipeline baselines only: the identities of the layer projections the pipeline projection embeds.
